title: Better every week
sub: The third film of Small steps, measured, the fourth series of Data management: improve the team's own way of working, a little every week. From September 2027, Helena keeps half an hour every Friday: one measure, one small change, tried for a week, then kept or dropped out loud, and each kept change written into the procedure it changed.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's sunlit plaster: the team's rooms in daylight, with sheets pinned to the wall. Its colours mean the same in every film: blue is plans and design (the pocket card's method, the Friday half-hour, the procedures' pages), green is value or something done (a change kept, the better way, what got better), amber is waiting or a cost (the long way, the six days, the minutes a change costs), and orange is data (the measures).
